frontmatter:
name: EventTix Hub
description: Билети за кино, концерти и театър. A Bulgarian афиш set in one Cyrillic type family and three spot inks.
colors:
  paper: "#F3F2EE"
  sheet: "#FBFAF7"
  ink: "#171614"
  ink-muted: "#57554F"
  rule: "#D5D3CC"
  field-border: "#85827A"
  film: "#2D3AB4"
  theatre: "#C3361C"
  concert: "#F1B20A"
  on-film: "#FAF9F6"
  on-theatre: "#FAF9F6"
  on-concert: "#171614"
  danger: "#B42318"
  success: "#1D7A3E"
  seat-held: "#8F8C84"
  seat-sold: "#C8C6BF"
  night: "#121211"
  night-sheet: "#1C1B19"
  night-ink: "#EEECE7"
  night-ink-muted: "#A9A69E"
  night-rule: "#383733"
  night-field-border: "#7B786F"
  night-film: "#3B49C8"
  night-concert: "#E3A40B"
  night-danger: "#FF8A7A"
  night-success: "#6FCF8E"
  night-seat-free: "#2A2926"
  night-seat-held: "#8A877F"
  night-seat-sold: "#45433F"
typography:
  display:
    fontFamily: "'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif"
    fontSize: "clamp(2.75rem, 1.6rem + 5vw, 5.5rem)"
    fontWeight: 800
    lineHeight: 0.9
    letterSpacing: "0"
  headline:
    fontFamily: "'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif"
    fontSize: "2.25rem"
    fontWeight: 800
    lineHeight: 1
    letterSpacing: "0"
  figure:
    fontFamily: "'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif"
    fontSize: "3rem"
    fontWeight: 800
    lineHeight: 0.85
    fontFeature: "'tnum' 1"
  title:
    fontFamily: "'Sofia Sans', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif"
    fontSize: "1.25rem"
    fontWeight: 700
    lineHeight: 1.25
  body:
    fontFamily: "'Sofia Sans', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif"
    fontSize: "1rem"
    fontWeight: 400
    lineHeight: 1.5
  label:
    fontFamily: "'Sofia Sans', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif"
    fontSize: "0.8125rem"
    fontWeight: 700
    lineHeight: 1.35
    letterSpacing: "0.05em"
rounded:
  none: "0"
  sm: "2px"
  seat: "10px 10px 4px 4px"
spacing:
  xs: "4px"
  sm: "8px"
  md: "16px"
  lg: "24px"
  xl: "48px"
components:
  button-primary:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.ink}"
    textColor: "{colors.sheet}"
    typography: "{typography.body}"
    rounded: "{rounded.sm}"
    padding: "10px 20px"
    height: "44px"
  button-primary-hover:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.ink-muted}"
    textColor: "{colors.sheet}"
  button-secondary:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.sheet}"
    textColor: "{colors.ink}"
    rounded: "{rounded.sm}"
    padding: "10px 20px"
    height: "44px"
  input:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.sheet}"
    textColor: "{colors.ink}"
    rounded: "{rounded.sm}"
    padding: "10px 12px"
    height: "44px"
  badge-type:
    textColor: "{colors.ink}"
    typography: "{typography.label}"
    padding: "0 0 2px"
  hold-badge:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.sheet}"
    textColor: "{colors.ink}"
    typography: "{typography.label}"
    rounded: "{rounded.sm}"
    padding: "6px 10px"
  hold-badge-urgent:
    backgroundColor: "{colors.danger}"
    textColor: "{colors.sheet}"
